data.hypothesis: With the same per-thread mapping, global-memory accesses, rsqrtf, and target-mass cancellation, forming (G * neighbor_mass * invDist) and (invDist * invDist) independently may shorten the dependent multiplication chain for each pair. data.notes: Only the reciprocal-cube multiplication order changes. The self-interaction branch remains to avoid evaluating a potentially non-finite mass contribution multiplied by a zero displacement. No speedup or correctness result is claimed before controller evaluation.
transformations: Keep one output per thread, the pairwise global-memory strategy, explicit rsqrtf, G=1, softening, update order, and the self-interaction skip.
